# 2 Baruch Chapter 25 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Second Fast and Dialogue

---

**1** He answered me: You too will be kept safe until that time comes — the time of the great sign that the Most High will perform for all the people of the earth at the end of the age.

**2** And this will be the sign: terror and chaos will grip the people of the earth; they will plunge into terrible suffering and be crushed under enormous torments.

**3** When people cry out in their hearts — because they have suffered so much — "The Mighty One has forgotten the earth!" — that is when it will come.

**4** And at that moment, when the Most High is about to come and reckon with the world he made, he will signal the nations, and terrible tribulations will descend on them.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic rendering. The paradox at the heart of this chapter: maximum suffering coincides with divine visitation. The moment people give up on God is precisely when God acts. Verse 3's inner monologue gives the passage emotional depth.*
